entities.name: René Groebli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Groebli, sometimes spelt Gröbli, is an exhibiting and published Swiss industrial and advertising photographer, known for his expressionistic photo-books, his photojournalism, and photo-illustration, and expertise in dye transfer and colour printing.
